proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_floor
proposed_widenings.justification: Life Preservation sets a minimum result on a specific roll kind (death saving throw ≤ 9 → treated as 10). This is structurally distinct from modify_roll_numeric (additive flat delta applies unconditionally) and modify_roll_advantage (changes the roll mechanism). A conditional minimum-result guarantee requires its own atom shape: { kind: 'modify_roll_floor', on: RollKind[], minimum: number }.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you make a Death Saving Throw, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_hit_die_recovery
proposed_widenings.justification: Natural Healing Boost doubles HP restored whenever the bearer rolls a Hit Die during a short rest or similar recovery context. No existing trigger covers 'on Hit Die rolled' in PassiveOperation (only elapsed_time exists), and no effect atom covers a multiplicative scaling of Hit Die results. maximize_healing_received (Beacon of Hope) is not equivalent — it maximizes all received healing from any source, not a multiplier scoped specifically to Hit Die rolls.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you roll a Hit Point Die to regain Hit Points, double the number of Hit Points it restores.

notes: Passive family and magic_item kind fit (wearing_item condition, uncommon, requires attunement, destruction: none). Both mechanics are blocked by missing atoms. Life Preservation needs a roll-floor concept; Natural Healing Boost needs both a new PassiveOperation trigger kind (on_hit_die_rolled) and a new effect (multiply HD recovery by N). Neither can be approximated honestly with existing atoms — modify_roll_numeric is unconditionally additive, not a conditional floor; maximize_healing_received applies to all healing sources, not just HD rolls.
